sc: The chaotic crossbow warped dye kit is a cosmetic token reward from the Daemonheim Rewards shop that can be purchased for 500,000 dungeoneering tokens.
The dye kit was previously only available from the Dungeon Delve: Daemonheim Treasure Hunter promotion before being added to the Daemonheim Rewards shop.
A cheese wheel is created by churning a pat of butter, pot of cream, or bucket of milk at a dairy churn with level 48 Cooking.
Cheese wheels are untradeable; only the cheese wedges sliced from the wheels can be traded or sold.
Chilli con carne is a members-only food and cooking ingredient that can be created by combining spicy sauce with cooked meat.

sc: and thok letter (part 4) is a book obtained while training Dungeoneering as a reward for completing a dungeon which appears by the exit door after the boss monster is killed.
It can also be obtained as a monster drop from any monster in Daemonheim.
Once the book has been obtained once it is impossible to obtain it again.
The marid lamp pot was a lamp part won from the Squeal of Fortune and also obtainable through killing monsters and skilling.
A medium fallen star (Cooking) is an uncommon prize from Treasure Hunter that can be redeemed for bonus experience in the Cooking skill.
2× the experience given by a medium XP lamp.
Memory-storage bots are given to the player by the Archivist after handing in the Aagi, Seren, Juna, Edicts and Cres memory-storage bots.
Midnight Slayer Longbow is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override unlocked by completing level 84 of Hero Pass: Underworld.
The Mission report is given to the player by Noodle after trading him swamp tar and 5 feathers.
It is created by garnishing a Mixed dragon, with pineapple chunks and a pot of cream, requiring level 32 Cooking.
The note from the Jade Spider is a note found on Whale's Maw during the quest Curse of the Black Stone.
It is obtained by checking a tortle near the south-eastern dock on the island.
The novite longsword is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
The Ocean's Mage Wand is a main hand magic weapon cosmetic override that could be unlocked by progressing through the RunePass.
An Overhead Emotes: Halloween is an item obtained during the 2023 Halloween event by smashing Party Pumpkins and Smashing Pumpkins and performing rituals at Pete's pumpkin patch.
It can be redeemed, consuming the item after a confirmation prompt and unlocking the Pumpkin Joy, Pumpkin Sob, and Pumpkin Nauseous overhead emotes.
The passage of the abyss is a pocket slot item that can be created at level 118 Invention with an alchemical onyx, 50 magic parts, and a teleportation compactor.
It could be obtained by completing tasks during the Plague Doctor promotion on Treasure Hunter, and was later also made available through the Contagion promotion.
It is obtained by adding a root cutting to a plant pot.

sc: To get tier 10 in all of the 12 roles you must obtain 3,878,580 tokens which is equivalent to at least 38,785,800 experience (Level 110).
If the ring of kinship is converted into a role, the roleless version can no longer be obtained inside a dungeon except in F2P worlds.
It is unlocked by inspecting the Rocky pet, found while training Mining.
When taken to the dragon forge, found in the Ancient Cavern, a player can unite the three ruined dragon armour pieces into a dragon platebody with the use of a blast fusion hammer.
They are a possible reward from completing hard clue scrolls as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion, or from cremating at the Columbarium.
Trimmed rune armour cannot be made with the Smithing skill, nor can it be trimmed by any players.
The sapphire ring is made by using a gold bar on a furnace while having a sapphire and a ring mould in your inventory.
Sapphire rings are commonly obtained from bird's nests.

Sculpting chisel (Saradomin) is obtainable from Copernicus Glyph after building the same statue in the same location in the God Statues Distraction and Diversion for a total of four months at any time.
With the exception of the use of Distraction & Diversion reset token (monthly), the chisels take at least 4 months to obtain.
It can be unlocked after accumulating at least 3,600 Blessings of the Wolf at the Shrine of the Spirit Wolves.
Shoes (female, straps) is obtained from the Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distraction and Diversion.
Upon receiving a piece from the ringmaster, it becomes available as a cosmetic override in the Customisation interface.
There are four types of shoes which may be awarded to players.

Slime hunter golden tools.x: Slime hunter golden tools are used in the Slime is of the Essence Treasure Hunter promotion. After the event players could exchange any remaining tools for 130 experience each in any of the skills used in the event by talking to Peter in Rimmington.

sc: A Smithing XP lamp is a quest item given as a reward for completing Hearts of Sanguine.
It was made by combining a green charm with 88 spirit shards and a cockatrice egg.

Spirit gems, which are dropped by all monsters that drop a single charm and could be received from the Squeal of Fortune, functioned similarly to Runecrafting pouches and stored uncharged summoning pouches before an update.

Starbloom robes set.x: A Starbloom robes set is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items from Starbloom equipment with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

Strength flask.x: A strength flask is a potion flask containing six doses of strength potion. It is created by using strength potions on a potion flask. Only the six-dose flask is tradeable on the Grand Exchange, but lower-dose versions can still be traded directly with other players.

sc: Super mining potion is made by adding enriched calcified fungus to a mining potion (3), giving 167 Herblore experience.
Superior void knight deflector is an upgraded version of the void knight deflector which can be made by using a void knight armour patch on a void knight deflector.
The Risen Manacles are a feet slot cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing The Risen Pack.
It is found by reaching into the icy lake when creating the sled at the end of the quest.
An unlocked diary is found by searching Sandy's Desk in Brimhaven during the One Foot in the Grave miniquest.
The experience given by each unstable protean bar scales according to the player's Smithing level at certain intervals.
An utuku wand is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Fletching skill.
The warm key is obtained from a chest in the Smoke Dungeon.
Player must light all four torches in the corners of dungeon, and then search the chest in the centre of the dungeon to obtain the key.
Attempts to re-obtain the key will result in the player receiving the message "There is nothing inside the chest.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
Willow planks are items made from willow logs and are used in the Construction skill.
